EnvironmentName.description:
An Environment's name, unique across declared Environments and all
template instances because leases, run refs, and keep refs are named
after it. A Kubernetes DNS label.

ExecutionKey.description:
A digest of everything that decides what a unit's execution does:
`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

anyOf.description: The value, and when it was last read successfully.
No value yet for this receipt, with the driver's reason.

RunId.description: The UUID of one run, recorded in the `Nyl-Run-Id` trailer.

Uid.description:
The UUIDv7 of one incarnation of a unit. It fences every receipt,
checkpoint, and deletion.

UnitIdentity.description: A unit's identity in state documents.

apiVersion.description:
The unit's kind; empty only in a held marker, which `nyl hold` writes
for a unit it never rendered ([`DesiredUnit::held_marker`]).

uid.description: The incarnation; absent for a held unit without one.

UnitName.description:
A unit's literal `metadata.name`, unique per environment across all
unit kinds. A Kubernetes DNS label.

description:
A unit's latest observed values, `observed/units/<unit>/observations.yaml`:
what the driver read for the receipt whose execution key it names. A
record belongs to that receipt alone and goes when a new receipt replaces
it, so a value read from what ran before never satisfies a reference.
Contract: [Observed values](../../../../design/orchestration-core.md#observed-values).

at.description:
When the record was last written: a recorded read, never a read that
changed nothing.

run.description:
The run that produced the receipt the record was read for. A receipt
is new with every execution, even one with the same key, so a record
names it by its run too.

values.description: Each declared observation by name, as of its last recorded read.

title: ObservationRecord
